class.name: DisRecording
class.brief_description: A DIS recording in memory: datagrams with their times, which can be loaded, saved, inspected and played by a DisPlayer.
class.description: Holds a list of UDP datagrams, in time order, each with its Unix time and source and destination address. [method load] reads pcapng, pcap and pdulog files (the format is detected from the first bytes); [method save] writes pcapng or pdulog. Only datagrams that start with a plausible DIS header are kept; other traffic in a capture is skipped and counted in [method get_read_statistics]. Several PDUs bundled in one datagram stay together as one packet. Times are Unix times in seconds; [method get_time] and [method find_index] use seconds since the first packet. Recordings are made by [DisRecorder] or built by hand with [method add_packet] and played by [DisPlayer]. [codeblock] var recording := DisRecording.new() if recording.load("user://exercise.pcapng") == OK: print(recording.get_summary()) recording.save("user://exercise.pdulog") [/codeblock]

method.name: add_packet
method.description: Adds a datagram. [param unix_time] is its time in seconds since the Unix epoch; a negative value means now. The packet is inserted at its place in time order. The addresses are stored in the file when saved; for replay only [param source_ip] and [param source_port] are used.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all packets and the read statistics and error message.

method.name: find_index
method.description: Returns the index of the first packet at or after [param time], in seconds since the first packet. Returns [method get_packet_count] if there is none, and 0 for an empty recording.

method.name: get_bytes
method.description: Returns the bytes of the datagram at [param index]. Returns an empty array and prints an error if the index is out of range.

method.name: get_duration
method.description: Returns the time in seconds between the first and the last packet, [code]0.0[/code] if empty.

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Returns the message of the last failed [method load], or an empty string.

method.name: get_packet
method.description: Returns the packet at [param index] as a [Dictionary] with the keys [code]time[/code] (seconds since the first packet), [code]unix_time[/code], [code]bytes[/code] ([PackedByteArray]), [code]source_ip[/code], [code]source_port[/code], [code]destination_ip[/code] and [code]destination_port[/code]. Returns an empty dictionary and prints an error if the index is out of range.

method.name: get_read_statistics
method.description: Returns what the last [method load] read and skipped, as a [Dictionary] with the keys [code]frames[/code], [code]not_udp[/code], [code]fragments[/code] (IPv4 fragments are skipped), [code]not_dis[/code] (UDP datagrams that do not start with a plausible DIS header), [code]filtered[/code] (other port than requested) and [code]truncated[/code].

method.name: get_start_time
method.description: Returns the Unix time in seconds of the first packet, [code]0.0[/code] if empty.

method.name: get_summary
method.description: Returns a [Dictionary] describing the contents: - [code]packets[/code]: number of packets. - [code]duration[/code] and [code]start_time[/code]: as [method get_duration] and [method get_start_time]. - [code]pdu_types[/code]: a [Dictionary] from PDU type number to how many packets have that type. - [code]exercises[/code]: the exercise IDs seen. - [code]entities[/code]: number of distinct entity IDs in Entity State PDUs. - [code]sites[/code]: the sending applications seen, as strings of the form [code]"site:application"[/code]. Only the first PDU of each datagram is examined.

method.name: get_time
method.description: Returns the time of the packet at [param index] in seconds since the first packet. Returns [code]0.0[/code] and prints an error if the index is out of range.

method.name: load
method.description: Replaces the contents with the file at [param path], using [FileAccess] (so [code]user://[/code] works). The format is detected from the first bytes. If [param port] is greater than 0, only datagrams to or from that UDP port are kept. Packets are sorted by time. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.OK] if the file was read, the file open error or [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_FILE_CORRUPT] if it could not be read or is empty, and [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_FILE_UNRECOGNIZED] if its format is not understood; see [method get_last_error].

method.name: save
method.description: Writes the recording to [param path]. [param format] chooses pcapng or pdulog; with [constant FORMAT_AUTO] the extension decides ([code].pdulog[/code] gives pdulog, anything else pcapng). Returns the file error if the file cannot be opened or written, otherwise [constant @GlobalScope.OK].

constants.constant: Choose the format from the file name: [code].pdulog[/code] is pdulog, anything else is pcapng.
The pcapng capture format used by Wireshark.
Plain text with one datagram per line: time since start, source, destination and the PDU as hex.
